purpose:
Independent research scorer. Reads completed reports/audio and optional residue overrides.

No rendering, fitting, per-note normalization, or source/model edits. The flags
are review triggers; no numerical score certifies physical studio placement.

limits: Harmonic power is native output, not internal modal energy or free decay.
Jumbo open E has no lower neighbor on the standard low-E string; its neighborhood test remains one-sided and must be reviewed with F/F#/G.
No per-note normalization. Gain-invariant H1/(mean H2,H3) and local note excess are reported alongside absolute levels.
Flags are explicit listening/review triggers, not a fitted target or proof of good studio placement.

force_transfer.formula: Conjugate modal pair real biquad numerator; F=1,M/F=-1,0,+1; existing capture cascade unchanged.
force_transfer.local_reference: Mean dB at +/-2 semitones; peaks/notches are interference/transfer measures, not source-Q estimates.

gain_reporting_note: After-distance-match fields subtract only the declared common gain; no fitted/per-note normalization and no audio edits.
